inspection.kind.inspection.description: Inspection kind: a standard inspection filled in from a template against an asset (blueprint inspections/README.md).

inspection.kind.itp.description: Inspection kind: an inspection and test plan whose steps carry hold, witness, review and surveillance points (blueprint inspections/README.md).

inspection.kind.rfi.description: Inspection kind that is a hold point, not a request for information (owner decision: keep RFI as hold point).

itp.point_type.hold.description: ITP point type label: a point that blocks downstream tasks until released (blueprint inspections/README.md).

itp.point_type.witness.description: ITP point type label: a point that notifies with a notice period and waiver rule (blueprint inspections/README.md).

itp.point_type.review.description: ITP point type label: a review point on an ITP step (blueprint inspections/README.md).

itp.point_type.surveillance.description: ITP point type label: a point that is sampled rather than checked every time (blueprint inspections/README.md).

itp.step.status.pending.description: ITP step status label: the step is pending (blueprint inspections/README.md, itp_steps status pending/ready/in_progress/released/waived/rejected).

itp.step.status.ready.description: ITP step status label: the step is ready (blueprint inspections/README.md, itp_steps status pending/ready/in_progress/released/waived/rejected).

itp.step.status.in_progress.description: ITP step status label: the step is in progress (blueprint inspections/README.md, itp_steps status pending/ready/in_progress/released/waived/rejected).

itp.step.status.released.description: ITP step status label: the step is released (blueprint inspections/README.md, itp_steps status pending/ready/in_progress/released/waived/rejected).

itp.step.status.waived.description: ITP step status label: the step is waived (blueprint inspections/README.md, itp_steps status pending/ready/in_progress/released/waived/rejected).

itp.step.status.rejected.description: ITP step status label: the step is rejected (blueprint inspections/README.md, itp_steps status pending/ready/in_progress/released/waived/rejected).

inspection.source.manual.description: Inspection source: created by a user from the register or the create wizard (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.source.scope_task.description: Inspection source: spawned by a scope-of-work task (INSPECTIONS-01; SCOPEWORK-03 creates these).

inspection.source.reinspection.description: Inspection source: a re-inspection of an earlier performed inspection (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.source.import.description: Inspection source: brought in by a data import (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.error.asset_not_found.text: That asset does not exist or is not visible to you.
inspection.error.asset_not_found.description: Error message for ASSET_NOT_FOUND when creating an inspection (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.error.template_not_published.text: That form template has no published revision to inspect with.
inspection.error.template_not_published.description: Error message for TEMPLATE_NOT_PUBLISHED when creating an inspection (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.error.no_inspection_workflow.text: No inspection workflow is set up for this tenant or project.
inspection.error.no_inspection_workflow.description: Error message for NO_INSPECTION_WORKFLOW: no active approvals definition for the inspection record type (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.error.not_completed.text: Only a performed inspection can be re-inspected.
inspection.error.not_completed.description: Error message for NOT_COMPLETED when re-inspecting an inspection that is not yet performed (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.error.revision_mismatch.text: That form revision is not a published revision of the chosen template.
inspection.error.revision_mismatch.description: Error message for REVISION_MISMATCH when the named revision is unpublished or belongs to another template (INSPECTIONS-01).

inspection.error.not_editable.text: Answers cannot be changed while the inspection is in this state.
inspection.error.not_editable.description: Error message for INSPECTION_NOT_EDITABLE: answers are saved only in the states ADR 0041 §6 allows (INSPECTIONS-02).

inspection.error.unknown_field.text: That question is not on this inspection's form.
inspection.error.unknown_field.description: Error message for UNKNOWN_FIELD: an answer names a field key the pinned form revision does not have (INSPECTIONS-02).

inspection.error.answer_invalid.text: One or more answers are not valid for their questions.
inspection.error.answer_invalid.description: Error message for ANSWER_INVALID: an answer has the wrong type, is not one of the options or is out of range (INSPECTIONS-02).

inspection.error.field_not_visible.text: That question is hidden by an earlier answer, so it cannot be answered.
inspection.error.field_not_visible.description: Error message for FIELD_NOT_VISIBLE: an answer names a field that the current answers hide (INSPECTIONS-02).

inspection.error.duplicate_answer.text: The same question or answer id appears more than once in this save.
inspection.error.duplicate_answer.description: Error message for DUPLICATE_ANSWER: one save repeats a field key or a client id (INSPECTIONS-02).

inspection.error.review_permission_requi.text: Only a supervisor allowed to edit during review can change answers now.
inspection.error.review_permission_requi.description: Error message when answers are saved in supervisor review without approvals.inspection.review, 'Edit Inspection during Review' (INSPECTIONS-02, ADR 0041 §6).
